newsitem.title: JAPAN: Mitsubishi Elec to build solar power system plant.
newsitem.headline: Mitsubishi Elec to build solar power system plant.

text.p: Mitsubishi Electric Corp said on Thursday it would invest a total of about 15 billion yen by the end of 2000 for a new plant to produce solar-power systems for homes.
Mitsubishi aims to capture 30 percent of market share in the year from April 1, 2000, the electric machinery maker said in a statement.
Construction of the new plant, to be located in Nagano prefecture, northwest of Tokyo, will start this August, it said.
The plant is expected to start operation in April 1998 and shipments will start in August 1998, it said.
Demand for the solar-power systems are expected to grow sharply as the Japanese government is promoting the use of such systems, the statement said.
Mitsubishi spokesmen were not immediately available for further comment.
